message.content:
100+页MAPK信号通路详解

丝裂原活化蛋白激酶(mitogen-activated protein kinase, MAPK), 一种丝氨酸-苏氨酸蛋白激酶。丝裂原, 顾名思义, 最早发现该激酶参与细胞有丝分裂。所有的真核细胞都能表达MAPK, 从酵母到人类都高度保守。

细胞凋亡与MAPK

红杉资本

Control, Anti-NGF, Anti-NGF + ERK, Anti-NGF + JNK, Anti-NGF + p38]
[Chart: Relative ERK kinase activity
Control, Anti-NGF, Anti-NGF + ERK, Anti-NGF + JNK, Anti-NGF + p38]
[Chart: Relative JNK kinase activity
Control, Anti-NGF, Anti-NGF + ERK, Anti-NGF + JNK, Anti-NGF + p38]
[Chart: ERK phosphorylation
Control, Anti-NGF]
Zhengui Xia et al., Science, 1995
  • 一般认为, ERK抑制细胞凋亡
  • p38与JNK促进凋亡
🔊

MAPK信号通路

红杉资本
[Diagram: MAPK Signaling Pathway
Receptors -> Kinases -> Transcription Factors -> Gene Expression]
  • 多级调控, 级联放大
  • 基于磷酸化的信号传导形式
  • 相对简单、直线、单一的传导方式
Jing Yuan Fang and Bruce C Richardson, Lancet Oncol, 2005
🔊
